title: Ingestion and private object lifecycle

subtasks.description: Define an ingestion ledger keyed by workspace, source and external event ID, with payload-hash conflict behavior.
subtasks.progress_note: IngestionRecord ledger keyed by (workspace, source_type, external_event_id) with a database unique constraint; canonical payload digest (source type, external source id, media sha256/size, file name, title, language, provider extra; declared content type excluded); nine canonical source types (FILE_UPLOAD produced today by console and API-key uploads, provider recorded as provenance). Case A same identity + same payload -> 202 idempotent replay of the existing conversation/root job (no second meeting, job, object, reservation or dispatch), 410 when the conversation was deleted; case B same identity + different payload -> 409 ingestion_conflict, first event never overwritten, conflict_count/last_conflict_at under a row lock, audited with ids; case C different identity + same media -> workspace duplicate_media_policy (allow links duplicate_of_id, reject -> 409 duplicate_media, nothing created), server-side enum setting via PATCH /admin/workspace-settings. Single-transaction claim: workspace row lock, policy, ledger insert (unique index decides concurrent claims), then create_upload_job; the loser resolves the winner's row. ORM immutability guard (only conflict bookkeeping and the SET NULL links may change). GET /ingestions[/{id}] and the ingestion field on the upload/detail responses under meeting:read with record scope; ingestion_records in the tenant-only RLS set (34 forced). Migration f7b1d3e5a9c2: table, workspaces.duplicate_media_policy, backfill of one ACCEPTED row per legacy conversation with a recording and root job (provider backfill, event id = job idempotency digest, same canonical digest), RLS re-applied, lossy downgrade documented; pre-ledger keys replay through the job digest. Verified locally: SQLite whole suite 224 passed / 34 skipped; PostgreSQL 16.15 as homayar_app focused suites 49 passed incl. RLS probe, two-thread concurrent claims (identical, conflicting, reject policy) and the head->downgrade->upgrade round trip with a real upload; check-migrations exit 0; explicit downgrade -1 / upgrade head / alembic check clean; frontend types only (tsc build, eslint, vitest green). Product commit e7a596e1. See ADR 0016.

subtasks.description: Harden streamed/resumable upload limits, MIME/signature checks and bounded ffprobe/decode validation.
subtasks.progress_note: Media validation pipeline hardened in backend/media/validation.py: signature pre-check refuses executables/archives/documents/images and foreign container-family bytes before any subprocess (ffprobe stays the authority for what it recognises); bounded ffprobe unchanged (fixed argv, no shell, probe/analyze/allocation caps, timeout); duration plausibility floor for compressed audio (MEDIA_MIN_BYTES_PER_SECOND, default 64; PCM exempt because the demuxer clamps to the bytes present, measured: a WAV header claiming 3600 s over 100 bytes probes as 0.003 s); bounded ffmpeg decode of a prefix with -xerror, single thread, timeout, output discarded (MEDIA_DECODE_PROBE_SECONDS default 30, FFMPEG_PATH/FFMPEG_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) which catches corrupted MP3/FLAC frames and garbage tails that the header-only probe accepts (measured ~50 ms per file). Every refusal carries a stable code and a terminal flag; transient tooling failures answer 503. Terminal refusals of a staged payload are REJECTED ledger rows under the event identity (reason, media digest/size, provenance, no conversation/job/object) with an ingestion.rejected audit; same payload replays the refusal without re-inspection, different payload conflicts; transient and pre-staging refusals are audited only and leave the identity free; rejected rows are never a live duplicate. Migration a8c4e2f6d1b9 tightens ck_ingestion_accepted_reason (rejected rows need a reason; lossless both ways). Verified locally: test_media_validation.py 40 (mocked subprocess), test_media_fixtures.py 21 against real ffprobe/ffmpeg 8.1 with lavfi-generated fixtures (all eight supported containers pass probe+decode; forged extension and non-media refused without spawning; garbage/text fail the probe; corrupted mp3/flac/tail refused only by the decode; truncated hour-long WAV clamped and undecodable; implausible opus refused; decode timeout/unavailable transient), test_ingestion_ledger.py rejection scenario; SQLite whole suite 266 passed / 34 skipped; PostgreSQL 16.15 as homayar_app focused suites 50 passed; check-migrations exit 0; a8c4 downgrade/upgrade/check clean with the constraint verified by a refused insert. Product commit 4e82281e. See ADR 0016 (amendment).

subtasks.description: Store quarantined originals privately; authorize object promotion only after validation and record checksums/channel metadata.
subtasks.progress_note: First-class media_objects table (ADR 0017): one row per stored byte stream — ORIGINAL (at most one per conversation, partial unique index) and derived kinds NORMALIZED/ENHANCED/CHANNEL_DERIVED/CLIP/EXPORT that must name their source (check constraint) — with storage backend/key, content type, container, size, sha256, duration, channels, sample rate, filename, producer, ingestion/job links, organization/workspace/conversation, lifecycle_state (ACTIVE, RETENTION_PENDING, DELETION_PENDING, DELETED, LEGAL_HOLD), retention, deletion request/reason/time, legal hold (time, reason, actor), integrity (UNVERIFIED/VERIFIED/MISSING/CORRUPT) and last_verified_at; ORM guard keeps content columns immutable; recordings.media_object_id links the recording to its ORIGINAL. Service backend/services/media_lifecycle_service.py: register_original (inside create_upload_job from the digest-verified stored object), register_derived (inherits tenant/conversation/ingestion/retention, refuses non-live sources), request_deletion/mark_deleted/delete_objects/retire_meeting_media (state first, bytes second, idempotent, failed removals stay pending), place/release_legal_hold (hold keeps bytes and records the request; release resumes it), verify_integrity (re-reads bytes, audited). Meeting deletion and delete-after-processing go through the lifecycle; pre-ledger recordings fall back to direct removal. Routes GET /meetings/{id}/media (meeting:read, no storage key) and POST /meetings/{id}/media/{media_id}/verify (meeting:update +csrf). media_objects in the tenant-only RLS set (35 forced). Migration b9d5f3a7c2e8: table, indexes, recordings column, backfill of one ORIGINAL per recording (provider backfill, ingestion/job links, DELETED when the recording was soft-deleted), RLS re-applied, lossy downgrade documented. Verified locally: SQLite whole suite 272 passed / 36 skipped (3 min 59 s) and the affected suites (media lifecycle, processor, meetings, fault injection, uploads) 22 passed / 4 skipped after the review fix; PostgreSQL 16.15 as homayar_app focused suites 12 focused modules (media lifecycle, ledger, RLS, processor, uploads, meetings, matrix, tenant scope, stage checkpoints, fault injection, PostgreSQL guarantees, storage providers) 94 passed (3 min 11 s) incl. RLS probe and the head->downgrade->upgrade round trip with a live and a deleted conversation; check-migrations exit 0; explicit downgrade -1 / upgrade head / alembic check clean. Product commit d8066f90. See ADR 0017.

subtasks.description: Implement retry-safe finalize/abort and orphan reconciliation for database/object partial failures.
subtasks.progress_note: Retry-safe finalize/abort proven and orphan reconciliation added (ADR 0018). Request path unchanged: a commit failure after the object is stored rolls every row back, the route's abort removes the object and the identity is free for the retry; tests prove the abort, the retry (one meeting/job/ingestion/media row, one reservation per metric) and a hundredfold replay of one finalization (one conversation, one usage effect, 99 replay audits) and that the WP06 invariant checker reports nothing afterwards. Storage contract: ObjectStorage.iter_objects(tenant_id) (key, size, last-modified, completeness; only owned keys under the tenant prefix) and purge_incomplete(tenant_id, older_than) (local temporaries; S3 has no multipart uploads to abort) in both backends. Sweep backend/jobs/media_reconciliation.py (Celery beat media-reconciliation, python -m entrypoint), per workspace under the tenant context and bounded: retries deletion_pending rows past the grace through delete_objects; lists the tenant prefix and reports objects without a live row (media rows not deleted, checkpoint artifacts, pre-ledger recordings) older than the grace — removal only when MEDIA_RECONCILIATION_REMOVE_ORPHANS is enabled, audited without keys (media.orphans_reported / media.orphan_removed); flags live rows whose bytes are absent as integrity missing through verify_integrity (never fabricated or removed); purges incomplete leftovers; a listing failure leaves the workspace untouched. Settings MEDIA_RECONCILIATION_{INTERVAL,GRACE}_SECONDS, _BATCH_SIZE, _REMOVE_ORPHANS. Verified locally: whole SQLite suite 286 passed / 36 skipped (two halves, 281 s + 178 s); focused reconciliation/storage/lifecycle/ledger 50 passed / 5 skipped; PostgreSQL 16.15 as homayar_app PostgreSQL 16 focused batch 71 passed (reconciliation, storage providers, media lifecycle, RLS, ingestion ledger incl. 100x replay + abort/retry, fault injection, tenant scope); earlier 14-module batch 114 passed; alembic check: no schema change. Product commit 01232be6f7a3abdb4e3c6e24b903bc7c6de69cd6. See ADR 0018.

subtasks.description: Qualify one supported S3/private storage implementation through contract tests, including multipart and access denial.
subtasks.progress_note: Shared storage contract suite backend/tests/test_storage_contract.py (ADR 0019) run against the real LocalObjectStorage on a disposable directory, S3ObjectStorage over a controlled fake client (conditional create/412, 403 AccessDenied, 404 vs NoSuchBucket, transport failure, pagination incl. empty truncated page, incomplete body, body closure) and an opt-in live S3-compatible target (backend/tests/_live_s3.py, marker live_s3: HOMAYAR_LIVE_S3_TEST=1 + disposable bucket/tenant prefix/keys; exact created keys removed; SDK logging muted) skipped by default and reported NOT_RUN/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Coverage: bounded/empty/boundary input, actual-vs-declared checksum, idempotent token writes and conflicts preserving the existing object, interrupted and non-byte streams (no object, no temporaries, identity free), missing vs denied vs transient vs unavailable outcomes kept distinct for read/exists/delete/list, exists never False on a fault, deletion faults preserve the object, lazy pagination bounded by the consumer, foreign shapes under the prefix skipped, purge removes only stale temporaries/orphan sidecars, another tenant's key / traversal / malformed tokens / invalid tenant ids refused before any backend call, provider AccessDenied on the write leaves nothing authoritative. Single-request proof on the real boto3 SDK path (botocore Stubber, every API operation name recorded): exactly one PutObject with exact ContentLength (unknown-length input spooled), oversized input issues no request, If-None-Match:* on token writes with 412 resolved by SHA-256 comparison (PutObject+HeadObject, no delete), failed generated upload cleaned up while a failed token upload never deletes, no multipart or transfer helper in the adapter source. Product fixes found by the suite: S3 NoSuchBucket/PermanentRedirect (HTTP 404) were classified as object-missing -> now StorageError s3_bucket_unavailable for every operation; local open/lstat/unlink faults other than ELOOP/ENOTDIR/EISDIR/ENAMETOOLONG were InvalidObjectKeyError or raw OSError -> now local_read_failed / local_stat_failed / local_delete_failed (delete idempotent under concurrent removal); default ObjectStorage.purge_incomplete validates the tenant id. Verified locally: ruff clean on changed files; contract suite 93 passed / 41 skipped (live target); relevant SQLite regression (storage providers, reconciliation, lifecycle, checkpoints, fault injection, uploads API, ledger, meetings API) 73 passed / 11 skipped; PostgreSQL 16.15 focused batch 184 passed / 41 skipped (contract suite, storage providers, media reconciliation, media lifecycle, RLS, stage checkpoints, ingestion ledger incl. abort/retry and 100x replay, fault injection, tenant scope, PostgreSQL guarantees; 113 s; the skips are the live-target parametrisation); alembic check not required (no schema change). Live S3-compatible qualification NOT run (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: no designated disposable bucket/authorization). Product commit d8d8209b78782e42e51263e3ef489b3953e893e0. See ADR 0019.
